facts.fact: Expansao says the Agencia de Proteccao de Dados was created in October 2016 by Presidential Decree 214/16 and has operated effectively since October 2019.
Expansao reports the authority fined Empresa Publica de Aguas de Luanda the equivalent of USD 150,000 on 14 July 2026 for inadequate protection of customers' data and failure to notify it.

AGO.note: The tally of 15 fined firms and USD 2.5 million is the newspaper's own finding, not a count the authority published.

facts.fact: Expansao says the Personal Data Protection Law has been in force in Angola since 2011.
facts.system: Lei de Proteccao de Dados Pessoais

facts.fact: The Agencia de Proteccao de Dados has operated since October 2019 and fines companies under the data protection rules.
The authority fined Empresa Publica de Aguas de Luanda the equivalent of USD 150,000 on 14 July 2026 for breaching data protection duties.
facts.system: Lei de Proteccao de Dados Pessoais

facts.fact: Expansao reports the authority fined a company for failing to notify it and obtain its authorisation for an international transfer of personal data, so a rule requiring authorisation is in force.
facts.system: Authorisation for international transfer of personal data

facts.fact: Expansao reports the authority fined Crescer Tech the equivalent of USD 505,000 in June 2026 for sending personal data to a cloud outside Angola without notifying it or obtaining authorisation.
facts.system: Authorisation for international transfer of personal data

facts.fact: Expansao reports the authority fined Maxam the equivalent of USD 150,000 in April 2024 for illegally transferring a citizen's personal data to the United Kingdom.
facts.system: Authorisation for international transfer of personal data
